title: Red dunes of Sossusvlei
description: Red dunes of fine sand along the road to Sossusvlei are a unique landscape in Namibia, on the way from Sesriem to the Sossusvlei pan.

title: Google car with bitten rear corner (C26, C35, C36, C43)
description: This Google car has a distinctive bite-like mark on the rear corner of the window. It is only found on four roads: the C26, C35, C36 and C43. If you are heading south-west, it is the C26.
